newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bans use of shopping coupons.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bans use of shopping coupons.

text.p: Shanghai has banned the use of shopping coupons by city shops and supermarkets to attract customers, the Xinhua news agency reported on Monday.
Many stores in the city have been giving away the coupons to people who spend a certain amount of money as an inducement to buy more.

A recent survey showed that department stores, supermarkets and other shops had started to use such coupons only in the past few months of this year and that their use had proliferated in December, the news agency said.
The city government has issued a new regulation banning commercial enterprises from using the coupons and warned of severe punishment for managers who violate the regulation, it said.
The issue of VIP, discount and credit cards without a name attached was also forbidden, the agency added.
A rapid increase in the number of retail outlets in Shanghai has led to fierce competition and the use of incentives to try to attract customers.
